pacific-islands.title: Veiyanuyanu ena Pasivika
pacific-islands.description: Papua Niukini, Viti, Yatu Solomoni, Vanuatu, Niu Kaletonia, Palau, Maikaronisia, Yatu Marisali, Nauru, Tuvalu kei na Yatu Gilbert e Kiribati — Port Moresby, Suva, Nadi, Honiara, Port Vila, Nouméa kei Majuro.

south-central-us.title: Na Ceva e Loma ni Amerika
south-central-us.description: Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi kei Alabama — Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Little Rock, New Orleans, Louisville, Nashville, Memphis, Jackson kei Birmingham.

west-polynesia.title: Samoa kei Toga
west-polynesia.description: Samoa, Samoa ni Amerika, Toga, Niue, Tokelau kei Wallis kei Futuna — Apia, Pago Pago, Nukuʻalofa, Alofi kei Mata-Utu; Upolu, Savaiʻi, Tutuila kei na yanuyanu e Toga.

mariana-islands.title: Guam kei na Yatu Mariana e Vualiku
mariana-islands.description: Guam kei na Yatu Mariana e Vualiku — Hagåtña, Tamuning, Dededo, Saipan, Tinian kei Rota.

greenland.title: Greenland
greenland.description: Greenland — Nuuk, Sisimiut, Ilulissat, Qaqortoq kei Tasiilaq; na vanua vulavula ni ice, na Ilulissat Icefjord kei na fjord e ceva.

bermuda.title: Bermuda
bermuda.description: Bermuda — Hamilton, St. George’s kei na Royal Naval Dockyard, na tikina ni yanuyanu kei na baravi qele damudamu.

belarus.title: Belarus
belarus.description: Belarus — Minsk, Gomel, Mogilev, Vitebsk, Grodno kei Brest; na veikau na Belovezhskaya Pushcha kei na veivuvu e Polesia.

channel-islands.title: Yatu Channel
channel-islands.description: Jersey, Guernsey, Alderney, Sark kei Herm — St Helier, St Peter Port kei Gorey.

faroe-islands.title: Yatu Faroe
faroe-islands.description: Na Yatu Faroe — Tórshavn, Klaksvík, Runavík kei na yanuyanu e tinikawalu, na nodra koro, ruku ni vanua kei na bati-ni-baravi.

svalbard.title: Svalbard
svalbard.description: Svalbard kei Jan Mayen — Longyearbyen, Barentsburg kei Ny-Ålesund; na glacier kei na fjord e Spitsbergen.

malta.title: Malta
malta.description: Malta, Gozo kei Comino — Valletta, Sliema, St Julian’s, Mdina, Victoria kei na Three Cities.

madagascar-islands.title: Madagascar kei na Yanuyanu ni Wasa Idia
madagascar-islands.description: Madagascar, Comoros, Mayotte, Réunion, Mauritius kei Seychelles — Antananarivo, Toamasina, Moroni, Mamoudzou, Saint-Denis, Port Louis kei Victoria.

sudan.title: Sudan
sudan.description: Sudan — Khartoum, Omdurman, Port Sudan, Kassala, El Obeid kei Nyala; na vanua e sota kina na Blue Nile kei na White Nile kei na pyramid e Meroë.

cabo-verde.title: Cabo Verde
cabo-verde.description: Cabo Verde — Praia, Mindelo, Santa Maria kei na yanuyanu e tini, mai Santo Antão ki Brava.

sao-tome-principe.title: São Tomé kei Príncipe
sao-tome-principe.description: São Tomé kei Príncipe — São Tomé, Santo António kei na veikau kei na baravi ni yanuyanu e rua.

saint-helena.title: Saint Helena, Ascension kei Tristan da Cunha
saint-helena.description: Saint Helena, Ascension Island kei Tristan da Cunha — Jamestown, Georgetown kei Edinburgh of the Seven Seas.

bangladesh.title: Bangladesh
bangladesh.description: Bangladesh — Dhaka, Chittagong, Khulna, Rajshahi, Sylhet kei Cox’s Bazar; na Sundarbans kei na delta ni Ganges–Brahmaputra.

sri-lanka-maldives.title: Sri Lanka kei Maldives
sri-lanka-maldives.description: Sri Lanka kei Maldives — Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna, Trincomalee, Anuradhapura kei Malé; na vanua ulunivanua, Sigiriya kei na atoll.

vietnam.title: Vietnam
vietnam.description: Vietnam — Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang, Hai Phong, Hue, Hoi An kei Can Tho; Ha Long Bay kei na Mekong Delta.

philippines.title: Filipaini
philippines.description: Filipaini — Manila, Quezon City, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Baguio kei Zamboanga; Luzon, Visayas, Mindanao kei Palawan.

indonesia.title: Idonesia kei Timor-Leste
indonesia.description: Idonesia kei Timor-Leste — Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan, Yogyakarta, Denpasar, Makassar kei Dili; Java, Sumatra, Bali, Borneo, Sulawesi kei Papua.

malaysia-singapore-brunei.title: Malaysia, Singapore kei Brunei
malaysia-singapore-brunei.description: Malaysia, Singapore kei Brunei — Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, George Town, Johor Bahru, Malacca, Kota Kinabalu, Kuching kei Bandar Seri Begawan.

myanmar.title: Myanmar
myanmar.description: Myanmar — Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw, Bagan, Mawlamyine kei na Drano o Inle; na buca ni Irrawaddy kei na ulunivanua e Shan.

cambodia-laos.title: Kabodia kei Laos
cambodia-laos.description: Kabodia kei Laos — Phnom Penh, Siem Reap kei Angkor, Battambang, Vientiane, Luang Prabang kei Pakse; na Mekong kei na Tonlé Sap.

colombia.title: Colombia
colombia.description: Colombia — Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Cartagena kei Bucaramanga; na Andes, na baravi ni Caribbean kei na Amazon.

venezuela.title: Venezuela
venezuela.description: Venezuela — Caracas, Maracaibo, Valencia, Barquisimeto, Mérida kei Ciudad Bolívar; Angel Falls, na Orinoco kei Isla Margarita.

peru.title: Peru
peru.description: Peru — Lima, Arequipa, Cusco, Trujillo, Iquitos kei Puno; Machu Picchu, na Drano o Titicaca kei na Sacred Valley.

ecuador.title: Ecuador
ecuador.description: Ecuador — Quito, Guayaquil, Cuenca, Manta kei Baños; na Avenue of the Volcanoes, na Amazon kei na Yatu Galápagos.

bolivia.title: Bolivia
bolivia.description: Bolivia — La Paz, El Alto, Santa Cruz, Cochabamba, Sucre kei Potosí; na Drano o Titicaca kei na Salar de Uyuni.

chile.title: Jili
chile.description: Jili — Santiago, Valparaíso, Concepción, Antofagasta, La Serena kei Punta Arenas; na Atacama, na Lake District, Patagonia kei Easter Island.

paraguay-uruguay.title: Paraguay kei Uruguay
paraguay-uruguay.description: Paraguay kei Uruguay — Asunción, Ciudad del Este, Encarnación, Montevideo, Punta del Este kei Colonia del Sacramento.

guianas.title: Na Guiana
guianas.description: Guyana, Suriname kei French Guiana — Georgetown, Paramaribo, Cayenne kei Kourou; Kaieteur Falls kei na veikau ni Guiana Shield.

falklands.title: Yatu Falkland
falklands.description: Na Yatu Falkland — Stanley, Goose Green kei na yanuyanu e East Falkland kei West Falkland.

australia.title: Ositerelia
australia.description: Ositerelia — Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Hobart, Darwin kei Canberra; na Great Barrier Reef, Uluru kei na Outback.

new-zealand.title: Niusiladi
new-zealand.description: Niusiladi — Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Dunedin kei Queenstown; na Southern Alps, Fiordland kei Rotorua.

british-columbia.title: British Columbia
british-columbia.description: British Columbia — Vancouver, Victoria, Kelowna, Kamloops, Prince George kei Whistler; na Coast Mountains, Vancouver Island kei na Okanagan.

canadian-prairies.title: Na Prairies e Kenada
canadian-prairies.description: Alberta, Saskatchewan kei Manitoba — Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Saskatoon, Regina kei Banff; na Rockies, na prairies kei Churchill e Hudson Bay.

ontario.title: Ontario
ontario.description: Ontario — Toronto, Ottawa, Mississauga, Hamilton, London, Kingston kei Thunder Bay; Niagara Falls, na Great Lakes kei Algonquin Park.

quebec.title: Quebec
quebec.description: Quebec — Montréal, Quebec City, Laval, Gatineau, Sherbrooke kei Saguenay; na St. Lawrence, na Laurentians kei na Gaspé Peninsula.

atlantic-canada.title: Kenada e Atalanitika
atlantic-canada.description: New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, kei Newfoundland kei Labrador — Halifax, St. John’s, Moncton, Saint John, Fredericton kei Charlottetown; na Cabot Trail kei na Bay of Fundy.

northern-canada.title: Kenada e Vualiku
northern-canada.description: Yukon, Northwest Territories kei Nunavut — Whitehorse, Yellowknife, Iqaluit, Dawson City kei Inuvik; na Arctic Archipelago kei na Uciwai o Mackenzie.

hong-kong-macau.title: Hong Kong kei Macau
hong-kong-macau.description: Hong Kong kei Macau — Hong Kong Island, Kowloon, New Territories, Lantau kei na Macau Peninsula, Taipa kei Coloane.

antarctica.title: Antarctica
antarctica.description: Antarctica — McMurdo Station, Scott Base kei Villa Las Estrellas; na Antarctic Peninsula, na yatu South Shetland, na Ross Ice Shelf kei na ulunivanua o Erebus. E tini na mape ena 85° ki na ceva ka sega ni yacova na South Pole.
